summary: Iter52 — All 3 enhancement features verified end-to-end (17/17 backend pytest pass, 3/3 frontend pages render). (1) Per-compound branding: GET/PUT /api/compounds/{id}/branding work; 403 for unrelated user (security role); 400 on invalid hex ('red', 'not-hex'); PUT persists primary_color/secondary_color/accent_color/brand_label/tagline/signature_text and a fresh GET returns same values; PDF /api/reports/compound/{id}/summary?month=2025-01 returns valid PDF (%PDF- magic bytes) using branded styles. Frontend /app/branding renders compound selector, color pickers (3), 6 color preset buttons, live preview pane, save & preview PDF buttons. (2) Scheduler analytics: /api/reports/scheduler/status returns {total_runs:23, success_runs:23, failed_runs:0, success_rate:1.0, by_kind:{summary, statement} each with {total,success,failed,rate}, monthly_trend[6 months], recent[40]}. Frontend /app/reports → 'عرض سجل الإرسال' reveals 4 KPI cards (إجمالي 23 / نجاح 23 / فشل 0 / معدل 100%), by_kind grid (SUMMARY 100%, STATEMENT 100%), 6-month bar trend (2030-01, 2030-12, 2031-02), and runs table. (3) SMTP Health: GET /api/system/smtp-health/stats?hours=24&threshold=0.30 returns full schema {window_hours, total, success, failed, success_rate, failure_rate, alert(bool), alert_threshold, by_mailbox, trend, recent_failures}; non-admin (security) → 403; alert false when total<5 even at threshold=0.10; POST /test-send by app_owner → 200 {sent, to, mailbox} and smtp_health collection increments by 1; POST /test-send by security → 403; after test-send the by_mailbox['main'] entry appears with avg_duration_ms. Frontend /app/smtp-health renders 4 KPI cards + by_mailbox table (main, 100%, 351ms avg) + test-send form. Email tracking integration confirmed: send_email writes to smtp_health on every attempt. Regression: login, /api/2fa/status, /api/audit-logs, /api/compounds, /api/reports/compound/{id}/(occupancy|invoices|summary) all 200.

action_items: Optional: investigate the 403 console error on admin layout page-load (low-impact polling endpoint) — possibly the new SMTP-health auto-poll firing when a non-owner is on a different page.

Recommend resetting branding fields to compound defaults at the end of test runs by allowing PUT to accept `null` to unset (current PUT can only OVERWRITE; cleanup left brand_label/tagline/signature as empty strings).
critical_code_review_comments: compound_branding.py PUT uses dot-notation $set (good — preserves other branding keys). However, hex-color regex is permissive (only checks startsWith '#' and length 4-9). Consider stricter validation: re.fullmatch(r'#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}', v).
compound_branding.py — when payload is empty ({}), the code passes {'$set': {}} which is a no-op MongoDB op. Slightly wasteful; consider short-circuit returning early.

smtp_health.py /test-send accepts arbitrary `to_email` query param without validation. Should validate as email + reject obvious abuse vectors (e.g. external bounce harvesting). Consider Pydantic EmailStr.

smtp_health.py /stats trend bucketing by hour-string slicing relies on ISO-format timestamps. If any timestamp is stored as datetime (not str) the slice yields garbage key. Verify EmailService writes string ISO consistently — it does, but worth a regression test.
smtp_health.py alert logic correctly gates on (total>=5 AND fail_rate>threshold) — good. Consider exposing `min_volume` as a query param for tunability.
scheduler_status — by_kind only includes 'summary' & 'statement' (hard-coded). If a new kind is added (e.g. 'reminder'), it won't show up. Consider distinct() over kinds.
branding.py get_compound_branding falls back to compound.name for brand_label and compound.logo_url for logo — good defensive default that means non-branded compounds still produce decent PDFs.
